title: Manager of Record temporary absence
rule_summary: For a planned Manager of Record absence expected to last 30 days or longer, a Massachusetts pharmacy must appoint a Board-registered Interim Manager before the absence. Before the planned absence, the Manager of Record must perform a controlled-substance inventory signed by both the Manager of Record and Interim Manager. An unplanned absence likely to last 30 days or longer requires appointment within five days; an absence of 100 days or more requires an application for change of Manager of Record.
exam_relevance: Tests a real operational handoff and inventory duty rather than only the general statement that the Manager of Record is responsible for compliance.

numeric_facts.conditions: Unplanned absence likely to last 30 days or longer
Manager of Record away from position

common_confusions: The five-day appointment rule applies to an unplanned qualifying absence, not a planned one.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
